final_message:
I implemented the pattern matchers in `src/match.ts` and the permission checks in `src/permissions.ts`, following the README. `npm test` now passes all 12 tests.

- **`matchAction`**: `*` matches everything. A pattern ending in `:*` matches only actions that start with the prefix and have something after it. Any other pattern must match exactly.
- **`matchResource`**: Empty segments are dropped first. Segments are compared one by one, `*` matches one segment, and `**` matches zero or more. It uses a memoized matcher, so patterns with many `**` segments can't blow up exponentially.
- **`isAllowed`**: Denies are checked first, so any matching deny returns false. Otherwise it returns true only if some matching allow rule exists. Roles missing from the policy are skipped. I used `Object.hasOwn`, so a role named `constructor` doesn't pick up an inherited property.
- **`allowedActions`**: Filters the candidates through `isAllowed`, keeping their order.

I also spot-checked README edge cases the tests don't cover: `doc:*` against `doc:` and `doc`, `a/**/b` against `a/b`, leading and doubled slashes, and `a/**` against `a/`. All behaved as the README describes.
